_readme: Hand fixes merged in last by `npm run data:build` and `npm run data:offline`. Keys are school ids. Set any College field (undergrads, tuition, acceptance, control, founded, conference, mascot, short, aliases, city, state, lat, lon, name). Use {"exclude": true} to drop a school. An unknown id with name, city, state, lat and lon adds a new school. The football section patches scripts/data/football.tsv the same way.
